posts.title: New Paper: Neotype for Red winged Blackbird
posts.description: I recently had a paper published in the Wilson Journal of Ornithology: Neotype designation for Red-winged Blackbird ( Agelaius phoeniceus ) . In short: Some dudes in the early 1900s tried to say Linnaeus described the bird based on a single description from South Carolina, but he had actually included many descriptions from across North and Central America. posts.description: This year, Alan Rubin and I helped organize and co-edit the PyConAU 2026 Academic Proceedings . It’s just been published!
